stories.title: El Gobierno enfría la idea de crear un máster y una escuela de opositores para acceder a las categorías de alto funcionario

en.title: The Government cools the idea of creating a master's degree and an opposition school to access high civil servant positions
en.summary: Spain's administration struggles to attract candidates for positions requiring workforce renewal, with 57% of state employees being over 50 years old.

stories.title: Así manipuló la Comunidad de Madrid las listas de espera en la Sanidad Pública

en.title: How the Madrid Community manipulated waiting lists in Public Healthcare
en.summary: Hospital emails and screenshots contradict the regional health authority's account of how it changed priority status for 57 patients.

stories.title: “Los vips ya no son gente muy importante, sino gente a la que exprimir, no hay excentricidad”: vuelve Manumission, la fiesta que revolucionó Ibiza

en.title: "VIPs are no longer very important people, but people to exploit, there is no eccentricity": Manumission returns, the party that revolutionized Ibiza
en.summary: The legendary Ibiza nightclub Manumission, which hosted countless celebrity nights, is making a temporary comeback.

stories.title: En un mundo disperso, la lectura es un acto de rebeldía

en.title: In a dispersed world, reading is an act of rebellion
en.summary: Reading requires learned skills including attention and concentration, and provides moments of pause amid constant distraction and agitation.

stories.title: El Gobierno confía en despejar las playas de Ceuta tras desbloquear la Audiencia Nacional el traslado al puerto

en.title: Government confident in clearing Ceuta beaches after National Court unblocks port transfer
en.summary: Spain's government pressed to unblock the transfer of migrants to a port after a suspension would have derailed its plan. The government believes the timing of the court decision was strategically damaging.

stories.title: El PSOE estudia una reforma para salvar el “vacío legal” planteado por el Supremo para devolver a migrantes que entren a nado

en.title: PSOE studies reform to address legal gap identified by Supreme Court for returning migrants who enter by sea
en.summary: The Socialist party is examining legislative changes to address a legal loophole regarding immediate migrant returns that the Supreme Court recently clarified. The opposition party had already filed a similar reform proposal.

stories.title: Un informe de 224 páginas que no responde a las preguntas fundamentales: quién ordenó la compra y por qué un ático

en.title: 224-page report fails to answer fundamental questions: who ordered the purchase and why a luxury penthouse
en.summary: Madrid's regional government released documentation about its purchase of a luxury apartment intended for occasional use by the president. The report does not clarify who authorized the acquisition or justify the property choice.

stories.title: La hora de la verdad de Shakira: la última jugada maestra de una artista sin límites

en.title: Shakira's moment of truth: the latest masterpiece of an artist without limits
en.summary: Shakira is staging a challenge she set for herself three years ago, beginning today in the capital. Those close to the artist describe her as having limitless ambition.

stories.title: Detenido ‘El Trompas’, presunto asesino de la estudiante española Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: 'El Trompas' arrested, suspected killer of Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico
en.summary: Mexican authorities captured Francisco Javier N in Cuautla, accused of killing 21-year-old exchange student Claudia Tacoronte last weekend. The suspect had shaved his head and changed his clothing.

stories.title: Detienen al presunto responsable del feminicidio de Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: Suspect in feminicide of Claudia Tacoronte arrested in Mexico
en.summary: Mexican authorities arrested 'El Trompas' in connection with the stabbing death of 21-year-old Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte in Cuautla, Morelos state. Mexico's Security Secretary announced the arrest via social media.

stories.title: Detenido el presunto responsable del feminicidio de Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: Suspected perpetrator of Claudia Tacoronte feminicide arrested in Mexico
en.summary: The Spanish student was killed during an altercation related to robbery, according to the Mexican governor. A suspect has been detained in connection with the incident.

stories.title: La Audiencia Nacional autoriza las carpas para migrantes en el puerto de Ceuta

en.title: National Court authorizes migrant tents at Ceuta port
en.summary: Spain's National Court rejected a police union's request to block temporary tent shelters for migrants in Ceuta. The government can proceed with the measure to address the migration crisis.

stories.title: Bankinter acelera el crédito en Irlanda y Portugal

en.title: Bankinter accelerates credit in Ireland and Portugal
en.summary: Bankinter is expanding its financing operations in Ireland and Portugal, with these markets gradually increasing their contribution to the overall portfolio.

stories.title: Maíz y remolacha de quinta gama a ritmo de 'country'

en.title: Fifth-range corn and beets at country music pace
en.summary: Huercasa, a Castilian-Leonese family company and European leader in fifth-range vegetables that exports 85% of its production, has hosted the country's largest country music festival for 11 years.

stories.title: El seguro ofrece rentabilidades al ahorro conservador de hasta el 4%

en.title: Insurance offers returns up to 4% for conservative savings
en.summary: Insurance products are providing returns of up to 4% for conservative savers, with BBVA offering monthly and lifetime payments of 310 euros for an insurance contract with a 100,000-euro premium.

stories.title: El fondo agrícola de Harvard negocia la compra de Projar

en.title: Harvard's agricultural fund negotiates purchase of Projar
en.summary: Boston-based asset manager Solum Partners has won a process to become the new shareholder of Projar.

stories.title: Ángel Simón revoluciona la cúpula directiva de Indra

en.title: Ángel Simón revolutionizes Indra's executive leadership
en.summary: The president of Indra will present a new composition of the company's management committee, which will involve departures of senior figures from the group's previous period.
